name: piloxa-certified-mail
description: Send USPS Certified Mail from ChatGPT. When a letter has to go on paper with USPS tracking and a record of what was mailed (a demand letter, a dispute, a notice to a landlord or tenant, a cancellation, a debt validation request), Piloxa checks it, prices it and hands back a review link. You read the exact pages, pay and approve; Piloxa prints it, pays the postage and gives it to USPS, with tracking and an optional Electronic Return Receipt showing who signed for it. No printer and no post office trip. Preview free; verify your email when you send. Nothing is mailed or charged until you approve. U.S. addresses.

interface.longDescription:
Piloxa mails letters for you: a productivity tool that sends a letter or document from your conversation by real USPS Certified Mail, without a trip to the post office, with USPS tracking and proof of what was sent.

Use it when a letter has to go on paper by Certified Mail: you want the recipient to sign for it, or a lease, contract or lawyer says notice must go by certified mail. Write the letter here — a security deposit demand, a notice to vacate, a lease termination, a cease and desist, a cancellation, a warranty claim, a formal dispute — or hand over a finished PDF. Piloxa checks the recipient address, prices the job and hands back a review link. You open the link, see the exact document that will print, the recipient, the service and the exact total, and only then pay and authorize. Piloxa then prints it, puts it in an envelope, pays the postage and hands it to the Postal Service.

You get USPS tracking and, if you ask for it, an Electronic Return Receipt: the electronic record of who signed for it. After it is mailed you keep the mailing record: the document exactly as it printed, the recipient, the date it entered the mail, the USPS tracking number and the delivery result.

Nothing is printed, mailed or charged from inside the conversation. No account is needed to look. U.S. destinations.
